profile.name: GPIB通信适配器
profile.description: 这是一种将计算机与采用 IEEE-488/GPIB 接口的实验仪器连接起来的通信适配器，常见形式为 GPIB-USB 或 GPIB-以太网桥接器。它用于实验室中对万用表、源表、示波器、频谱仪等台式仪器进行远程控制、命令发送和数据采集。
profile.description_en: This is a communication adapter that links a computer to laboratory instruments using the IEEE-488/GPIB interface, commonly as a GPIB-to-USB or GPIB-to-Ethernet bridge. It is used in labs for remote control, command transmission, and data acquisition from bench instruments such as multimeters, source meters, oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers.

registry.name: National Instruments Gpib Communicator
registry.description: Gpib Communicator驱动，支持address/close/eoi/eos/flush input等11个操作。
